headline: As of 2026-10-01: 836,441 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 28 of 50 states, D+36.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 836,441 early/mail ballots cast so far across 28 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+36.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (282,381), New Jersey (134,390), Florida (82,004).
